provenance.notes: Cross attention with no mask and no diagnostic row: the minimum contract, where every encoder key contributes.
Cross attention over a key count that is not a multiple of the split tile, so the last partition absorbs the remainder.
Cross attention with an alternating key-padding mask. A zero entry adds the filter value, so a masked key keeps a tiny but non-zero weight.
Every mask entry is zero. The additive filter leaves the row uniform, where a knockout mask would return zeros; this case separates the two readings.
A non-default mask filter value, small enough that masked keys still carry visible weight.
Cross attention emitting the pre-softmax score row. The values are the scaled dot products, so a post-softmax reading would show every row summing to one.
The score row is emitted after the mask is added, so the masked columns sit a filter value below their neighbours.
An explicit scale overrides the default reciprocal square root, and the emitted score row shows it directly.
A single encoder key: the softmax is degenerate and the output is that key's value row.
Whisper-scale cross attention geometry at one head, where the key count is far larger than the head dimension.
Cross-attention with 4 heads and head width 4, the minimum that fills one four-element vector, over an 8-token key/value cache.
The float16 twin of the plain cross route: operands and output narrow, while the score and online softmax stay float32.
Float16 operands with a float32 score row, the combination the schema allows by typing the diagnostic output independently.
A float16 score row, so the diagnostic output narrows with the operands.
Self attention appending token four into a cache of capacity eight. Only the first four rows are attended; the rest keep their past values.
An empty cache: the appended token is the only key, so the output is its own value row.
Self-attention with a shared past/present buffer sized for 8 tokens; 6 past tokens plus the appended token leave one row unused. 4 heads, head width 16.
A key-padding mask over the live length only; the cache rows past it are outside the mask and outside the softmax.
An additive score bias broadcast across batch and heads, the shape upstream's own self-attention test uses.
A score bias with a real head dimension, so the head stride is non-zero and a broadcast reading would mix heads.
Both additive terms at once. The bias is added before the mask, matching the reference's term order.
A score bias with a batch dimension but a broadcast head dimension, the mixed stride pair.
An explicit scale on the self route, overriding the reciprocal square root of the head size.
Whisper-base decoder self-attention geometry, with the cache half filled.
Every live key is masked. The additive filter keeps the row a uniform average rather than collapsing it to zeros.
Self-attention with a shared past/present buffer sized for 448 tokens across 2 batches; 31 past tokens are extended by the appended token. 8 heads, head width 64.
A cache large enough for the retain copy to stage the full eight words per lane, the deepest rung, in float16.
The float16 twin of the plain self route, including the float16 cache the append pass writes.
Float16 operands with both additive terms, so the bias narrows with the tensor type while the score stays float32.
